name: Mirror‑City Reflections
description: A city of mirrored skyscrapers standing on a perfectly still lake, each building reflecting a kaleidoscopic version of itself, while floating gondolas drift lazily below.
prompt: Silvery glass skyscrapers reflected in a glass‑smooth lake, each building showing multiple shifting reflections, floating gondolas with soft lanterns, early dawn light, dramatic symmetry, hyperrealistic, no text, serene urban fantasy.
caption: Step into a city that mirrors itself—every view is a portal to infinite possibilities.
